content_zh: 不仅没有人帮忙，此时听着唐敬的惨叫声，很多人看热闹不嫌事大，还在起哄。　　“精彩，太精彩了，真没想到今日的沈园诗会，一波三折精彩至极。”　　“哈哈，也难怪刘大人这么生气，今日的沈园诗会，明显就是唐家的家族秀，让我们亲眼见到唐家从兴盛跌入尘埃，又从尘埃爬上神坛。”　　“喂，别胡说，唐逸可是和唐家没有关系。”　　“什么叫没关系？唐逸是唐家的血脉吧？他现在是三品京兆尹，封忠勇侯，只要是唐家的血脉，就是唐家祖上冒青烟。”　　“我草，这么一说，我怎么觉得唐敬是故意的……”　　“……”　　然后，唐敬就被打得更惨了！　　“呵呵，贱妇就是贱妇，难登大雅之堂，竟然以为能使点手段，就能与我等平起平坐？可笑！”　　女席这边，有人看着唐敬的惨状，也对颜霜玉发了难。　　听到这话，一群女人看向颜霜玉的目光，也都非常的不善起来。　　刚才，这个女人还在她们面前嘚瑟，向他们科普育儿经，教她们怎么教育一个三元及第的状元。　　那时候，她们虽然不爽却还只能赔笑脸，谁让她们没有一个三元及第的儿子呢？　　结果，全是假的！　　一个教儿子舞弊偷盗诗词的女人，竟然敢在她们一群当家主母面前嘚瑟，教她们怎么做好一个母亲。　　奇耻大辱啊！　　“不，不，这是误会。”　　看着一群女人要吃人的目光，颜霜玉脸色煞白，吓得魂飞魄散：“我说的都是真的，是唐逸那废物蒙蔽了陛下，是……”　　话没说完，被人冰冷打断。　　“哼，到现在了，还敢颠倒黑白？打她！”　　一群女人立即一拥而上，当场逮着颜霜玉的头发，将她狠狠甩在地上。　　随即指甲巴掌都往颜霜玉脸上招呼，打得颜霜玉惨叫连连，不断求救求饶。　　姜云娜看着这一幕，吓得腿一软直接跌坐在了地上。　　她想要逃，刚才她可没少帮颜霜玉羞辱唐逸，可现在吓得浑身瘫软，连爬的力气都没有了。　　“不，不……不关我的事。”　　见到一群嫡女走来，姜云娜红着眼拼命摇头。　　“哼，不关你的事？要不是你，我们能对唐逸那么大的敌意吗？都是你的错！”　　啪！　　话音刚落，一个巴掌便落在了姜云娜的脸上，当场将姜云娜打倒在地。　　随即一群怒火中烧的嫡女，巴掌也全都往姜云娜身上招呼，什么嫡女贵女形象都不管了。　　远处，御史姜正在打唐敬，看着他自己女儿被打，却毫无办法，只能化悲愤为力量，一拳狠狠砸在唐敬的鼻子上！　　户部侍郎的位置，老子不要了！　　“我……我身上有伤，别打我。”　　舞台上，早就吓趴在地上的唐浩看到爹娘被打，下意识缩到了角落里，抱着头瑟瑟发抖。　　一群士子才子睨着他，冷笑：“打你？你也配让我们动手？”　　打人，有辱斯文，有辱斯文……一群士子才子看向远处那群朝廷大臣，脸皮都在抽搐。　　“我们呢？我们要不要也打一下？”　　武将这边，有将领下意识咽了咽口水，娘咧，这种场面好久没有见到了。　　以前，都是他们在早朝的时候，被文官追着打，现在文官打文官，哈哈，狗咬狗一嘴毛啊！　　“刚才谁说老夫看错人的？站出来老夫和他聊聊。”　　狄苍背着双手，虎目扫过一众武将。　　被他的目光扫过，一群武将当时吓得腿一哆嗦，身体顿时矮了半截。　　“咳咳，老将军，我就开个玩笑，咱就别开战了吧！”　　“对对，是我们的错，我们不该怀疑老将军的目光。”　　“老帅依旧目光如炬，我等佩服，佩服……”　　“……”　　一群武将立即求饶。　　刚才唐逸独自面对暗京楼，他们觉得唐逸是在胡闹，在丢人现眼。　　结果唐逸真一刀，将暗京楼给全灭了。　　以最小的代价，灭了暗京楼上百高手，牛得一批！　　“哼，一群狗眼看人低的家伙，现在还觉得唐逸没资格训你们吗？”　　狄苍背着手，冷声道：“等真正开训了，你们最好都给老子好好训，这小子可不是那么好对付的，小心到时候后悔莫及。”　　众人闻言，顿时脸色讪讪，心头发毛。　　本来是看不上唐逸的，可要是这小子动用轰天炮怎么办？　　暗京楼都扛不住，他们也扛不住啊！　　湖畔。　　唐逸看着身后纷乱的场面，脸上都震惊了。　　这还都是大炎的最高层吧？竟然都这么在意形象的吗？众目睽睽之下群殴？　　“放心吧，唐敬死不了的。”　　炎文帝的声音传来。　　唐逸摇摇头，道：“我不是担心唐敬，我只是觉得……这群老贼的血性，用错地方了啊！”　　对外，他们软得一塌糊涂。　　炎文帝眼神也是微微一黯，看了一眼正在对唐敬拳打脚踢的大臣道：“你不知道有个词叫窝里横吗？他们就是窝里横的代表！”　　“不过，他们注定是要被淘汰的，大炎的未来，是属于你们年轻人的。”　　唐逸一怔，这话怎么有点耳熟？　　不对，不能被这老家伙洗脑了。　　他看向面容儒雅的炎文帝，道：“陛下刚才的话没说完吧？封赏的旨意何时下达？我现在是侯爷，我的侯府是不是得建一下？”　　“赏金千两，锦缎百匹，我也还没看到。”　　炎文帝一愣，当场一脚就踹了过去！　　“朕和你谈理想，你给朕说功利是吧？”　　“站好了，朕打不死你！”　　唐逸躲得远远的，将陈貂寺当挡箭牌。　　炎文帝瞪着唐逸，道：“想要建侯府？想要赏金千两？可以。”　　“朕现在没钱，等你收回户部的欠账，朕就给你拨款修建侯府，同时给你赏金千两。”　　唐逸一听难以置信地看向炎文帝，陛下，你还要点脸吗？　　合着你的赏赐全是口头嘉奖，没有一点实质的是吧？　　想要实质的，还需要我自己去拿？　　炎文帝背着双手，站得笔直，义正词严道：“朕，没钱。”　　没钱就是没钱，这脸不要也罢！　　唐逸扶额，这皇帝还真是个奇葩，真没谁了。　　“那就别扯淡了，直入正题吧！”　　“你让我做京兆府尹，一下子给我升这么快，到底有什么阴谋？”
content_en: Not only was there no one to help, but hearing Tang Jing's screams, many people were still booing despite the excitement."Wonderful, so wonderful. I really didn't expect that today's Shen Yuan Poetry Recital would be so exciting with twists and turns." "Haha, no wonder Mr. Liu is so angry. Today's Shen Yuan Poetry Reunion is obviously a family show of the Tang family. Let us see with our own eyes that the Tang family fell from prosperity to dust, and then climbed up to the altar from dust." "Hey, don't talk nonsense, Tang Yi isIt has nothing to do with the Tang family." "What does it mean?Tang Yi is a descendant of the Tang family, right?He is now a third-grade Jingzhao Yin, and as long as he is a descendant of the Tang family, he is the ancestor of the Tang family." "I don't think Tang Jing did it on purpose..." "..." Then, Tang Jing was beaten even worse!"Haha, a bitch is a bitch, she can't live up to the standards of elegance. You actually think that you can be on equal footing with me by using some tricks? Ridiculous!" On the ladies' side, someone looked at Tang Jing's miserable condition and also expressed difficulty with Yan Shuangyu.After hearing this, a group of women looked at Yan Shuangyu with very unkind eyes.Just now, this woman was lecturing in front of them, teaching them about parenting and teaching them how to educate a top scholar with a three-level diploma.At that time, even though they were unhappy, they could only smile. Why didn’t they have a son who passed three yuan?The result is all fake!A woman who taught her son to cheat and steal poetry dared to teach them how to be a good mother in front of a group of housewives.What a shame!"No, no, this is a misunderstanding." Looking at the cannibalistic looks of a group of women, Yan Shuangyu turned pale and was frightened out of her wits: "What I said is true. It was Tang Yi, that good-for-nothing, who deceived Your Majesty. It was..." Before she could finish her words, she was interrupted by someone coldly."Hmph, you still dare to confuse right and wrong now? Beat her!" A group of women immediately swarmed up, grabbed Yan Shuangyu's hair on the spot, and threw her to the ground.Immediately, he slapped Yan Shuangyu's face with fingernails and slaps, causing Yan Shuangyu to scream and beg for help and mercy.Jiang Yunna looked at this scene and was so frightened that her legs softened and she fell to the ground.She wanted to escape. She had helped Yan Shuangyu humiliate Tang Yi just now, but now she was so scared that she was paralyzed and she didn't even have the strength to crawl."No, no... it's none of my business." Seeing a group of legitimate daughters approaching, Jiang Yunna shook her head with red eyes."Hmph, it's none of your business? If it weren't for you, would we be so hostile to Tang Yi? It's all your fault!" Bang!As soon as he finished speaking, a slap fell on Jiang Yunna's face, knocking Jiang Yunna to the ground on the spot.Immediately, a group of angry legitimate daughters all slapped Jiang Yunna, regardless of the image of a legitimate daughter.In the distance, Censor Jiang was beating Tang Jing. Seeing his own daughter being beaten, he had no choice but to turn his grief and anger into strength and punch Tang Jing hard on the nose!I don’t want the position of Minister of Household Affairs anymore!"I...I'm injured, don't hit me." On the stage, Tang Hao, who had been lying on the ground in fear for a long time, saw his father and mother being beaten, and subconsciously shrank into a corner, holding his head and trembling.A group of scholars and scholars looked at him and sneered: "Hit you? Are you worthy of letting us do it?" Beating someone is an insult to politeness, an insult to elegance... A group of scholars and scholars looked at the group of court ministers in the distance, their faces twitching."What about us? Do we want to fight too?" On the general's side, some generals swallowed subconsciously. Mom, I haven't seen this kind of scene for a long time.In the past, they were chased and beaten by the civil servants during the morning court. Now the civil servants beat the civil servants, haha, a dog bites a dog!"Who said just now that I saw the wrong person? Come forward and have a chat with him." Di Cang put his hands behind his back and scanned the generals with his tiger eyes.When his gaze swept over them, a group of military generals trembled with fright, and their bodies suddenly dwarfed by half."Ahem, old general, I'm just kidding, let's not start the war!" "Yes, that's right, it's our fault, we shouldn't doubt the old general's vision." "The old general still has a bright eye, I admire it, I admire it..." "..." A group of military generals immediately begged for mercy.Just now Tang Yi was facing Anjing Tower alone. They felt that Tang Yi was fooling around and embarrassing himself.In the end, Tang Yizhen's sword destroyed Anjing Tower.With the minimum cost, you can destroy hundreds of masters in Anjing Tower, and you will gain a lot!"Hmph, you are a bunch of guys who look down on others. Do you still think that Tang Yi is not qualified to train you?" Di Cang put his hands behind his back and said coldly: "When the training starts, you'd better train me well. This kid is not that easy to deal with. Be careful when the time comes. You will regret it." When everyone heard this, their faces suddenly became sullen and their hearts grew hairy.Originally, I looked down on Tang Yi, but what if this kid used the sky-blasting cannon?Even Anjing Tower can't bear it, and neither can they!Lakeside.Tang Yi looked at the chaotic scene behind him with shock on his face.These are still the highest levels of Dayan, right?Are you all so concerned about your image?A group fight in full public view?"Don't worry, Tang Jing won't die." Emperor Yanwen's voice came.Tang Yi shook his head and said: "I'm not worried about Tang Jing, I just think...the bloody spirit of these old thieves has been used in the wrong place!" To the outside world, they were soft as a mess.Emperor Yan Wen's eyes dimmed slightly, and he glanced at the minister who was punching and kicking Tang Jing and said, "Don't you know there is a word called Wo Li Heng? They are the representatives of Wo Li Heng!" "However, they are destined to be eliminated. The future of Dayan belongs to you young people." Tang Yi was startled, why does this sound familiar?No, we can’t be brainwashed by this old guy.He looked at the elegant-faced Emperor Yanwen and said, "Have you not finished what your Majesty just said? When will the reward be issued? I am a Marquis now. Do I need to build my Marquis' mansion?" "I haven't seen the bounty of a thousand taels and hundreds of pieces of brocade." Emperor Yanwen was stunned and kicked him on the spot!"When I talk about ideals with you, you talk about utilitarianism to me, right?" "Stand still, I can't kill you!"
